fields.why: Table 1 gives nirsevimab receipt (row %) for five age groups at visit (59%, 48%, 45%, 33%, 25%), an outcome measured per ordered SPD group.
Age is the only SPD with 3+ groups; race (AI/AN vs other), sex and residence type have two groups each.
No test spans the age groups: the p<0.05 note covers characteristics by RSV season (two groups), and the VE CIs concern receipt vs nonreceipt. The mechanical flag is a false alarm.
